description:
Hangup does not append unsent captions to a sent request. The voice call is faked. In an eval, window.liveEmit(event) delivers event from Live (e.g. window.liveEmit({type: "session.input_transcript.delta", delta: "Hello ", start_ms: 0, end_ms: 400})); emit each event in its own eval, in the order given. window.liveSpeak(id, speech) speaks and delegates: it emits {type: "session.input_transcript.delta", delta: speech, start_ms: 0, end_ms: 900} and then {type: "session.delegation.created", offset_ms: 900, delegation: {id, target: "client"}}. window.liveNotes() returns the JSON of everything Shelley sent to Live. window.__voiceTracksStopped counts the microphone tracks stopped. "Start the call" means: click data-testid "live-call-header"; data-testid "live-bar" should contain "On call". "The exchange" is data-testid "live-exchange". "The message X" is the [data-testid="message"] elements whose text contains X (has_text; it collapses whitespace, so a line break is a space). Text checks on messages and the exchange compare whitespace-collapsed text: eval el.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, " ").includes(...) with expect true (or false for "not contain"), on every matching element. Once call "intercept" has run, the server's answer to a relay of events (POST .../live-session/<session>/events) carrying a delta "The live chat" is held back until call "release"; call "held" says whether one is being held. Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /c/final and start the call.
2. Call window.liveSpeak("hangup", "echo: save the whole transcript"). There should be exactly one message "Spoken request: echo: save the whole transcript" (the request).
3. Call "intercept". Emit {type: "session.output_transcript.delta", delta: "The live chat", start_ms: 1000, end_ms: 1800}. Call "held" should come to return exactly "true".
4. Emit {type: "session.output_transcript.delta", delta: " panel doesn't get too tall.", start_ms: 1800, end_ms: 3000}. The exchange should contain "The live chat panel doesn't get too tall.", and the request must not contain "The live chat".
5. Click data-testid "live-stop", then call "release". data-testid "live-bar" should be gone (count 0), and the request must still not contain "The live chat".
6. Navigate to /c/final again (a reload). The request must not contain "The live chat". Call "livetranscript rows" should return exactly "false".
